Name: StardewSpeak
Author: evfredericksen
Description:
Play Stardew Valley by voice.This mod is primarily made for people with limited use of their hands who want to play Stardew Valley without interacting with the keyboard or mouse.

StardewSpeak can be installed just like [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]any other SMAPI-based mod[/url]. Download the latest release and unzip its contents into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
Test out your microphone to ensure that it is able to clearly capture your speech. The speech engine uses about 2.5 gigabytes of RAM, so be
careful about running it alongside other RAM-intensive applications.
Currently, StardewSpeak is only usable on Windows 10.

Full documentation is available [url=https://github.com/evfredericksen/StardewSpeak]here[/url].
